row:
Previously known as IMV imaging, Vet Solutions are part of the IMV Technologies group and are world leaders in veterinary imaging including ultrasound, X-ray, digital image management (PACS), 3D and Endoscopy.  

We have been committed to helping our customers improve animal care for over 40 years. 

Established in 1983, our global headquarters are located in Scotland, with additional offices in Ireland, Belgium and Sweden.

Our Practice, Our Passion
